thread:
lee: Beginning rollout for schema.billing_payments_v1 during the quiet window. Pausing at pre-index lock to confirm no long transactions.

deploybot: Deploybot: start release/schema.billing_payments_v1 · canary=2/2 · status=quiesced

anya: @lee FYI last time a replication catchup caused a lock. can we require advisory lock + explicit session list and a 2m watch before applying index?

lee: yes. will acquire advisory lock and run the session check. holdpoint +5m.

srebot: SREbot: running session probe:
```
SELECT pid, state, now()-state_change AS age, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE query ILIKE '%billing_payments%' AND state <> 'idle';
```

srebot: result: 0 active sessions touching billing_payments. advisory lock free.

carlos: good to go. rollout note: if anything blocks index apply or p99 > 900ms for 3m, prepare rollback. rollback shortcut:
- curl -X POST https://flags.internal/feature/billing_payments_migration -d '{"on":false}'
- git checkout refs/tags/schema-billing-prev
- /deploy rollback release/schema.billing_payments_v1

deploybot: Deploybot: acquired advisory lock on primary · applying concurrent index

lee: applying index now. watching api p99 and write-errors. auto-rollback guard: if p99 > 1s for 2 consecutive mins OR write_errors > 0.3% in 5m, bot will post "rollback recommended". human ack required to run.

anya: p99 blip to 480ms at start, then stabilizing. backfill started with rate 150r/s.

deploybot: Deploybot: migration step create_index -> success. backfill running · eta=1h10m

lee: leaving monitoring on. will post into #ops if we escalate. thanks all. :thumbsup:
